changelog: v1: Split out of the former combined `chemicals` template.
_note: Split from the former combined chemicals template. NO DPP OBLIGATION EXISTS for paints and coatings: Directive 2004/42/EC (Decopaint) mandates a VOC declaration in g/l on the label and creates no passport, and paints are NOT in the ESPR first working plan (COM(2025) 187) — only a preparatory-study candidate, 2028 mid-term review at the earliest. The regulation block therefore points at the instrument actually in force, and every paint-specific field is offered, not mandated.
